answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the lagoon is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the timber of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each mirror has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal fqyr4.
